sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Bronze axe is the third one-handed axe. It can be used to chop down Ancient, Birch, Beech, Fir, Oak and Pine trees.
Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Its secondary attack is a slow but powerful overhead swing. This is perfect for removing tree stumps that are too low to hit with a normal swing.

Introduction. The Bronze axe is the third one-handed axe. It can be used to chop down Ancient, Birch, Beech, Fir, Oak and Pine trees.
Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Its secondary attack is a slow but powerful overhead swing. This is perfect for removing tree stumps that are too low to hit with a normal swing.
